services.desc: Beach Haven, NJ is the heart of summer fun on Long Beach Island, and there’s no better way to experience it than from the water. If you’re searching for a charter boat in Beach Haven or a unique LBI boat rental for your group, Queen City Cycle Boat offers an unforgettable way to cruise the bay, soak up the sun, and celebrate life on LBI! Whether you’re visiting Long Beach Island for the week or you’re a local looking to mix things up, Queen City Cycle Boat is one of the most popular group activities in Beach Haven and across LBI.
